definitions.full: H6974. quts I. [ קִיץ ] verb Hiph`il awake (|| form of יקץ ; Late Hebrew in Hiph`il (rare)); — Perfect 3masculine singular הֵקִיץ 2Kin 4:31 ; Ezek 7:6 ; 2 masculine singular וַהֲקיצ֫וֺתָ consecutive Prov 6:22 , etc.; Imperfect 1singular אָקִיץ 23:35 ; 3 masculine plural יָקִ֫יצוּ Jer 51:39 +; Imperative masculine singular הָקִ֫יצָה Hab 2:19 +; masculine plural הָקִ֫יצוּ Isa 26:19 ; Joel 1:5 ; Infinitive construct הָקִיץ Psa 17:15 ; 73:20 ; Participle מֵקִיץ 1Sam 26:12 ; — shew signs of waking, awake: 1 from sleep , a. 1Sam 26:12 ; Isa 29:8 (twice in verse); Psa 3:6 ; 73:20 ; 139:18 ; Prov 6:22 (doubtful line, see Toy). b. of ׳י Psa 44:24 awake [from sleep] to activity, so 35:23 (with ל of thing), 59:6 (c. infinitive purpose). c. from ecstatic sleep of prophets Jer 31:26 . 2 from sleep of death, with negative 2Kin 4:31 ; Jer 51:39 , 57 ; Job 14:12 ; of resurrection Isa 26:19 ; Dan 12:2 3 from stupor (of drunkenness) Joel 1:5 ; Prov 23:35 . 4 of inanimate thing Hab 2:19 ; compare אֵלָ֑יִח הֵקִיץ הַקֵּץ בָּא Ezek 7:6 the end cometh, it hath awaked unto thee (Co strike out הֵקִיץ , but the word-play favours it). — Psa 17:15 is put by Thes Ol Hup Du and others below 1a ; Ew De Che below 2 ; we below 1b ; Calv Now from night of distress and helplessness, and so Bae (psalmist representing Israel).
